title: Danny's DMT laser experiments reveal 'code' behind reality

tellings.quote: What what do you think about these um this buddy Danny who does these DMT laser defraction experiments? I'm sure

related.note: Same DMT laser 'code' phenomenon as telling 3, but Gallimore explains it as retinal laser speckle, not a code behind reality.

plain: A man Michels calls only "Danny" does experiments where he shines lasers through a diffraction pattern while on DMT, a powerful psychedelic drug, and the patterns are said to reveal a kind of code behind reality. Michels calls Danny his "buddy" and raises the experiments with the neuroscientist Andrew Gallimore in a 2025 episode, asking what he makes of them. Gallimore offers a different explanation, laser speckle, the grainy pattern any laser makes.
